chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Mahziyār narrated, saying:
I said to him: Some of your followers have narrated from your forefathers, peace be upon them:
"Every endowment fixed to a known term is binding upon the heirs, and every endowment to an unspecified term is ignorance, unknown, invalid, and returned to the heirs."
And you are more knowledgeable of the saying of your forefathers, peace be upon you and them.
So he, peace be upon him, wrote: "It is like that according to me."

key_terms.الْوَرَثَةِ: The heirs who inherit the property.
key_terms.عِنْدِي: According to my ruling or view.
key_terms.وَقْتٍ مَعْلُومٍ: A specified and known term or period.
key_terms.وَقْفٍ: An endowment or charitable dedication of property.

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a waqf that does not specify a known term?
ai.summary: This hadith concerns the legal validity of waqf and distinguishes between an endowment tied to a known term and one left unspecified. The Imam عليه السلام confirms that a waqf with a defined term is binding upon the heirs, while an unspecified one is invalid and reverts to the heirs.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5569 - Ali ibn Mahziyar narrated that he said:

I asked Imam (as): "Some of your followers have narrated from your forefathers, peace be upon them, that every endowment (waqf) specified for a known period is binding upon the heirs, but any endowment without a specified period is unclear, invalid, and rejected by the heirs.
You (as) are more knowledgeable about the sayings of your forefathers, peace be upon them."
Imam (as) wrote in response: "It is as you have mentioned according to my understanding."
